summary: Fixed CWE-481 in the bad() method: the if-condition used the assignment operator `=` instead of the equality operator `==`, so `isZero` was always overwritten to `true` and the branch always taken regardless of the random value. Changed `isZero = true` to `isZero == true` so the condition correctly compares the value, preserving the intended behavior of reporting when zeroOrOne is 0.
